actions.action: Track completion separately for each requested item
actions.mechanism: Calculate outstanding quantities from linked physical receipts, keeping supplier promises separate from delivery evidence.
actions.implementation: Add a shared item register beside existing accounting: requested quantity, confirmed quantity, received quantity, approved substitute allocation, outstanding quantity, and exceptions.
actions.check: Request ten units; receive four, then three. Verify three remain outstanding and another item's surplus cannot close this line.
actions.risk: Incompatible units or double-counted substitute allocations can misstate completion.

actions.action: Assign substitutions to a named independent approver
actions.mechanism: Separate substitution decisions from receipt recording; retain the original request and the decision rationale.
actions.implementation: Assign one of the other two staff as decision owner. Record proposed item, quantity conversion, rationale, decision, and timestamp; block requester approval.
actions.check: Attempt self-approval and verify rejection. Receive an undecided substitute and verify it remains visible without satisfying the original item.
actions.risk: An unavailable approver can delay closure; name an eligible backup.

actions.action: Make receipt entry duplicate-safe and preserve overages
actions.mechanism: Identify repeated receipt events without collapsing legitimate partial deliveries; flag excess quantities rather than silently truncating them.
actions.implementation: Store supplier, receipt number, line ID, item ID, quantity, and source image. Block repeated keys; review uncertain matches. Record overages separately with disposition owners.
actions.check: Enter one receipt twice, then a distinct partial delivery. Verify correct totals. Receive twelve against ten; verify a two-unit exception.
actions.risk: Reused receipt numbers require review rather than automatic rejection.

actions.action: Run a short daily exception review
actions.mechanism: Turn unresolved item states into owned next steps, and verify disputed receipt records against physical materials.
actions.implementation: Create filtered views for shortages, undecided substitutions, overages, and disputed receipts. Assign each a staff owner, next step, and due date; preserve correction history.
actions.check: Seed one exception of each type. Verify each has an owner and remains open until documented resolution, not merely supplier confirmation.
actions.risk: Physical recounts need usage records when materials have already been consumed.
